basic_details.job_title: KINFRA Project Management Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kerala Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation (KINFRA), through the Centre for Management Development (CMD), has announced 6 vacancies for Project Management Executive (Civil) and Project Management Executive (General) posts on a contract basis for a period of 2 years under recruitment 2026. Qualifications and eligibility vary by post, and the notified pay is Rs. 30,000 for both positions. Eligible candidates can apply online through the website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, from 14 October 2026 to 28 October 2026. The selection process involves

how_to_apply: Visit the official website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD) at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in.
Fill up all relevant fields in the online application form carefully.
Scan and upload the latest photograph in *.JPG format (file size less than 200 kB).
Scan and upload the full signature on a white paper in *.JPG format (file size less than 50 kB).
Submit the online application on or before 28 October 2026, 05:00 P.M.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for the upper age limit and experience is 01.10.2026. Qualifications must be from a recognized University or Institute, and applicants with equivalent qualifications must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority.

rows.qualification_required: B.Tech in Civil Engineering, preferably with an MBA and a minimum of one year of experience in the relevant field.
Degree with full-time MBA and a minimum of one-year of experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KINFRA Project Management Executive
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD) at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in. Fill up all relevant fields in the online application form carefully. Scan and upload the latest photograph in *.JPG format (file size less than 200 kB). Scan and upload the full signature on a white paper in *.JPG format (file size less than 50 kB). Submit the online application on or before 28 October 2026, 05:00 P.M.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test, group discussion, skill test or proficiency test, an interview, or any combination of these methods as determined by CMD.

faq.question: Q1. Is the appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis for a period of 2 years.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years as of 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be uploaded for educational qualifications?
faq.answer: Candidates must upload either the original certificate or the provisional certificate issued by a competent authority; mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements are not accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the latest experience certificate?
faq.answer: Experience certificates must include specific details like date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, signature, and seal of the authorised person. For the latest experience, an affidavit with employer details, designation, period, nature of job, tasks, and responsibilities may be uploaded.
